description: PowerShell functions to register applications and manage Windows file-type and protocol associations.
notes: Run `ps-sfta` to open an interactive PowerShell session with SFTA functions loaded. Windows 11 UCPD can block the script from changing protected extensions/protocols such as .pdf, http, and https; this manifest does not disable UCPD or bypass those protections. The script is pinned to upstream commit 22a3229.
